prompt: Act as a student-facing AI teaching assistant. Give executable Python that reports package file names, shapes, keys, missing values, duplicate keys, bus references, horizon metadata, and manifest validation status. Use clear repository-relative file paths and units, and begin with a small fixture test before scaling to ACTIVSg2000. Do not fabricate file contents or claim validation unless a manifest says validation_status: passed. Distinguish verified facts, interpretations, and unknowns, and include a verification checklist.
verification_checklist: Run the self-test before scaling to data/processed/activsg2000_scenarios_v1
Record the exact manifest and catalog files reported by the command
Check JSON keys/shapes and CSV columns/shapes, missing values, and duplicate keys
Check discovered bus references and report empty lists only as local evidence
Record horizon metadata in hours and preserve unverified_dependency as non-passed
Use only public or synthetic/instructor-approved data and do not claim DCOPF validation
review_notes: Pass after correction. Claims match README.md and docs/ACTIVSG2000_SCENARIO_PACKAGE.md, including topology counts, six blocks, calendar-derived hour horizons, instructional-year caveat, and unverified_dependency solver status. Replaced placeholder/stale code with a complete standard-library inspection script and executable synthetic --self-test, preserved units and unknowns, and kept private_information_present false.
